name: print-social-ad-vr-headset-blue-photo-bold-type
title: Blue Facebook ad for VR headset with bold red type
whatItIs: A wide-format ad on a flat blue background with a dramatic red-lit photo of a person wearing a VR headset, paired with a bold red slanted headline and dotted texture accents.
whatItMeans: Contrasting a cool blue backdrop against warm red lighting in the photo and headline makes the ad's focal elements pop forward with strong depth.
techniques: light the hero photo in a contrasting color to the flat background for depth
slant/rotate bold headline text slightly for energy rather than a static horizontal line
scatter a subtle dot-pattern texture in negative space to avoid a flat empty background

vocabulary.definition: adjusting the color tones of an image, often to push shadows/highlights toward a stylistic hue
